name: Baker's shop (boulangerie)
description: Village bakery, 12 x 10 m: an ashlar ground floor with a painted shopfront (two small-paned display windows, a lettered fascia, a striped awning, an iron sign bracket) under a rendered, shuttered upper floor and a steep tiled roof; at the back a domed brick bread oven projects from the bakehouse with its own tall stack. Shop and bakehouse with the oven mouth, two rooms above, two stairs.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
